text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nuuuugh...! Demi-glace omurice, carrot 
ajillo, shkmeruli...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Looks delicious...! But it looks greasy... 
That can't be good for pimples, can it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Simmered dishes or fish probably suit my 
body better, y'know... I know that... I 
know, but still...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah... The big city's got way too much 
delicious-lookin' grub, I tell yaaa~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Yukino Bijin is troubled by skin 
breakouts...
